name: Cravax the Claw

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat can take Ruin actions and has 1 personal Ruin

abilities.name: Borrowed Time
abilities.text: Make an attack as a Free Action against any target in range.

abilities.name: Malcontent Barrage
abilities.text: Activate the Barrage option from Battlefield Ruin.

abilities.name: Combat Stimms
abilities.text: Once per Round, this Threat can suffer 1 Shock to immediately take a Combat Action. Roll an Opposed Initiative Test if this interrupts an Agent's Turn.

note: No Tier row printed; class proposed (named Champion with 1 personal Ruin, but only 6 Wounds, so Elite rather than Adversary; GM may prefer A). Battlefield Ruin is a rule in the adventure's missions, not in this book's rules pages.
